Feasibility.title: Feasibility
Feasibility.description: search.feasibility: whether the structural preflight judged the query, and its refusal when it can have no solution.

game_file_version.description: Exact installed game executable version this identity resolved, as a dotted four-part string such as "2.0.2.0". There is no default.

versioned_resource_dir.description: Version-selected offline resource directory the bundle resolved to.

bundle_digest.description: Identity over every selected input, including version-invariant ones.

versioned_digest.description: Identity over only the files below the versioned resource directory.

resources_digest.description: Whole-root digest, retained as proof/diagnostic only.

context_digest.description: The version-bound digest that authorizes candidate, cache, and resume reuse.

legacy_context_digest.description: Pre-version identity digest, carried only as an explicit proof field.

production_authority.description: True only for a resolved production identity. A false value marks the opt-in, non-production legacy capture and must not authorize reuse.
